visualCharacteristics.layout: 2-3 equal columns of default content (text, images, buttons) side by side from 600px (3 columns from 900px), stacked on mobile. Option 'wide-left' splits two columns 2/3 + 1/3 on desktop

contentPattern: One row, one cell per source column, default content inside each cell (headings, paragraphs, images, button links). Extra rows lay out the same way; empty cells are dropped. Option 'wide-left' for 8/4 splits. Use columns-infobox instead when one column is a lone image at 1/3
